lines.en: : Hello, Aunt Niki. I did not expect to see you back in the room so soon. What a pleasant surprise.
: You’re up to something and I’m going to find out what it is.
: Me? I have never been up to anything at any point in my life. I am a normal teenage girl with normal teenage interests. Like skin-care and getting abortions.
: Ami, did you kill my little sister and hide her body in the bathroom?
: Still alive, Nee-chan! But thank you for caring!
: Well, if Noriko’s still alive and you weren’t in the process of murdering her, what-
: We were making out!
: What? And I missed it?
: You and Noriko...were making out.
: That is correct.
: In the bathroom.
: Tongues and all.
: That...is how that is done. Yes.
: I grabbed her boobs too. I’m a lesbian now, Aunt Niki. I have seen the light. You can have my dad all to yourself.
: Nothing but vaginas for me from here on out.
: You are a terrible liar. What’s really going on in there, Ami?
: Noriko! If you’ve started smoking or doing drugs or some shit, don’t do it in the hotel!
: Why not?! You aren’t responsible for the security deposit! Your production company is!
: Also, I’m not doing drugs! I’m just in here also being a lesbian!
: There you have it, Aunt Niki. Case closed. Nothing to see here. Unless you also want to make out with us. But that sounds logistically improbable.
: Logistically improbable? Is this rehearsed? Noriko! Get out of the bathroom!
: I can’t! I’m lost!
: Okay, okay! Fine! If you really want the truth...we...
: Well...we were...
: Having sex!
: You must be so ashamed! To think that I could do such a thing behind your back and desecrate the inn you reserved us just minutes after arriving!
: Please don’t tell my dad! I don’t want him to know about all of the lesbian sex I have with your little sister!
: Do I look like an idiot to you, Ami?
: Um...n...no? You look a lot like...the girl I just made sex-love to, though! And boy was it good.
: Noriko does this thing with her fingers where-
: Okay, Jesus! Whatever it is, I no longer care and I no longer wish to hear about it!
: You and Noriko can have as many secrets as the two of you want, but I will not let it interfere with the quality time we’re supposed to be sharing before my photo-shoot!
: Get your towel. We’re heading to the baths.
: To have lesbian sex with each other?
: OBVIOUSLY FUCKING NOT, AMI! I’M NOT GOING TO HAVE LESBIAN SEX WITH YOU! NOW, COME ON!
: You too, Noriko! I know you’re still alive and only half-gay in there!
: Wait! Don’t try to open the door! Noriko is-
: I’m...cumming!
: Ew! What the fuck?! Why would you say that to me even if you’re clearly lying about it?!
: Oh god! I can’t stop! This is the craziest orgasm ever! Ami’s raw sexual energy still has an effect on me even though she is no longer here!
: Fine! Stay in there, then! But don’t come crying to me when Patrice busts down the fucking door and drags you out of there at my command! Ami! Come!
The door to the hall slides open and the two of us can hear Ami and Niki disappear into the hall.
Well...I can hear Ami and Niki disappear into the hall. Noriko’s ears have likely been destroyed by exposure to loud music, so she’ll just have to take my word for it.
: Hah...you see how much trouble you almost got us into, Onii-chan?
: I don’t want to die in a bathroom. Do I look like Elvis to you? Do you really think I can move my hips the way he did?
: No, but I’d like to find out.
: Is that really how you should be speaking to your little sister? And also your future daughter in law if this thing with Ami and me works out?
: No, but it’s kind of just reflexive at this point and I’m sorry if it made you feel uncomfortable.
: Quite the opposite, actually. It made me feel too comfortable. And if I wasn’t currently on an all-sister diet, I imagine I’d be on my knees and bowing down to the patriarchy right about now.
: How many sisters have you eaten?
: None yet, but I can only assume the count will increase based on the current and inevitable trajectory your toxic polyamory will ultimately have on me in a romantic context.
: On the bright side, I actually don’t have an erection right now. So there’s no need for you to get on your knees for any sort of authority figure.
: Well, now I’m just offended. What sort of brother doesn’t get a hard-on when he’s trapped in a tight space with his doting little sister?
: Again, there’s so much room in here.
: No there’s not! Stop saying that!
: Noriko, really-
: Okay, okay! Fine! I’ll give you some room to breathe. But just know that I’m not happy about it! And also...extremely confused about what to do now.
: Well again, no erection. So-
: Not about that! I know how to give you one of those! I just don’t know what to do about hiding you from Nee-chan since she’ll get even more suspicious when I don’t go join her in the bath.
: Not if Ami distracts her with lesbian sex and Niki gets to fulfill her childhood dream of fucking every surviving member of a family.
: Wasn’t Nee-chan’s childhood dream being a mech pilot?
: Yeah. What did I say?
After waiting ten minutes for her sister and my daughter to be sufficiently naked, Noriko smuggles me out of the inn and past a sea of show-biz executives on the way to the rock garden.
She says that, through exploring with Kirin, she’s found a few spots where we should be able to get some privacy, but I’m still not really sure what the end goal is.
It’s not like she can just stay with me the entire weekend. She’ll have to go back to her sister at some point. So what becomes of me then?
And was coming here really worth the risk at all when it seems like Noriko just wants to...hang out?
: Oniiiiiii-chan~
Hah.
Why am I lying to myself again? Of course it was. And of course I’d want to hang out with her too as there’s probably no one better suited to just being a sibling to me.
Which isn’t to say I’ve had good luck with such a thing in the past, but...
That’s a bridge we’ll have to cross later.
For now, I’ll just play along and pretend I’m happier than I really am.
: So, big brother — now that I’m done yelling at you for putting my life at risk, let me say thanks for how you came all the way over here just to keep me company.
: Assuming, of course, that there’s no hidden motivation of wanting to either keep an eye on Ami or wanting to sleep with Onee-chan.
: I wouldn’t hide such motivations, I’d make them eerily apparent. But right now, you are my top priority since you’re the one who invited me here.
: Just because I’m the one who invited you here? Or because you loooove me?
: You know I feel weird about saying that. You can’t just ask me to out of the blue.
: Sure I can! It’s my job to annoy you, isn’t it? Go on, Onii-chan! Proclaim your love for your little sister! No one will hear it but her!
: Oniiiiii-chan~
: Fine. I love you.
: How much?
: What? We’re not done? I have to quantify it now?
: Only if you don’t want me to cry. So yeah — no big deal.
: I’ve made you cry enough, so let’s just go with whatever the maximum amount is.
: Maximum love?! You mean it, Onii-chan? Even though you’ve given me fewer orgasms than basically everybody I know?
: Is that really something you’re going to bring up in platonic mode?
: It’s not “platonic mode,” it’s “sister mode.” And sister mode comes with an endless supply of flirting and teasing that ultimately doesn’t lead to anything. Except for when it does.
: But when it does, it stays a secret. That only you and I can share. That is the glory of being siblings and knowing that, no matter what happens, you will always be number one in my heart.
: Always? Really?
: Of course. Why would I lie about that?
: I chased after you for years. You think I’d do that for just anybody?
: No. But I also think you’re mature and smart enough to work your way out of the magnetic field that everyone else you know has gotten caught up in.
: You mean, like...falling for someone else one day? Dating them and stuff?
: ...Right.
: How does that make you feel, Onii-chan? Like — if I suddenly had a boyfriend one day, what would you do about it?
: I would...try not to think about it.
: But you would think about it. Because you love me. And you want to protect me and keep me all to yourself. Which is exactly how I feel about you!
: But, you know...I think there’s an extra layer of suffering that younger siblings just sort of have to expect since it’s the older ones who obviously get to grow up first.
: For example, you and Nee-chan had your first kiss before I was even old enough to comprehend what kissing was.
: So of course I’d be jealous of all the stuff you can do that I can’t now that I’m old enough to understand the world around me.
: To be fair though, I don’t think there’s anything I can do that you can’t.
: Sure there is when you remember what your purpose here is.
: To...bang your sister?
: To teach, Onii-chan. Or shall I say — Sensei?
: Because you get to experience everything first, and because we’re so close, it’s only right that you pass all of that knowledge on to me so my life can be a little easier.
: Isn’t that the sole job of an older sibling, after all?
: Onii-cha-
: Disregarding...whatever that was leading to, do we have a plan in mind now? Or are we just aimlessly wandering around in hopes of not disturbing Niki’s motherly bonding opportunity?
: Noriko?
: Oh. Well...I guess the first thing we need to figure out is whether or not you actually want to stay the whole weekend or if this is just a...today sort of thing.
: I’ll obviously need a place to sleep if I’m staying for more than just today. And I can’t imagine there are any rooms available if Niki’s production company booked this place for a shoot.
: I can try and find you an empty one and say it’s for me? Everyone here obviously knows who I am, so I could probably pull it off.
: And I doubt there are no vacancies anyway. I think renting out the entire place was more just so Nee-chan’s fans couldn’t catch wind of the shoot and rent out rooms to creep on her.
: Yeah. I don’t even want to think of what Chika would do if she knew Niki was here.
: Is she still deluding herself into believing you somehow don’t know my sister despite our life-long connection?
: I’ve tried telling her, but I doubt she’ll believe me unless she sees it with her own eyes. The problem with that is I likely won’t live long enough afterward to know how she reacts.
: You think you’d be the one in danger and not Nee-chan?
: I’m not the one on posters all over her wall. I just have sex with her. Which I’m sure she’d also want to do with Niki, so...
: I’d put your poster on my wall, Onii-chan. In fact, I’d buy out the whole stock.
: Ayane could probably help you make them if you really want. She’s no stranger to hanging me on her bedroom wall.
: I might have to do that. Especially with Ami’s birthday coming up. A shirtless poster of you would make a pretty great gift, wouldn’t it?
: Better than anything I could give her. At least...in terms of things that aren’t attached to my body.
: Are you liking being a dad?
: Don’t really know.
: It only feels a little different. But I know it makes Ami happy, so...I think that’s where any “joy” comes from if there’s any there at all.
: I just feel bad for your sister. She’s trying really hard and Ami just...well, you probably already know since we’re here in the first place.
: Yeah.
: You know, it’s kind of weird. I haven’t seen her want something this badly since she started training to be an idol just to get back at you.
: And until Ami, I’d never really seen any interest from her in wanting to be a mom...at all.
: But she’s obviously older now and...I guess reconnecting with the love of her life has made her start thinking more about a future a little bigger than a poster on some girl’s wall.
: That’s...why I feel so bad. I can’t give that to her. Not...the way things are now, at least.
: Yeah...you’ve got to prioritize Ami before her. Yourself too. So I feel bad for Nee-chan as well.
: Maybe someday though. Do you agree, Onii-chan?
: With what? Settling down?
: Yeah. Settling down. Raising kids.
: Mini-vans...trips to the beach...family-pack deals on meat at the grocery store and trying to figure out how to work the new hot pot you picked up from Hard-Off last week.
: Sounds like you do when you’re going to be that specific about it.
: I do.
: It’s just sad, though...
: Because I’m always the one going with you to buy the hot pot. Or in the backseat of that mini-van, sandwiched between two kids throwing Cheetos at each other.
: But I’m never at the table with you when you eat. I never get to sleep in the same room. Hell, the only times I get to be alone with you at all are when Nee-chan visits our parents.
: Why is that the future I envision?
: Being...what, an aunt?
: Is this the life I subject myself to by being such a martyr all the time? I can’t even properly dream now?
: Sorry, I...
: Yeah.
: I don’t...really know what to say to that to-
: Then don’t say anything. I’m content just knowing you’re still there.
: And that there will always be a role for me in your life, even if it’s not the one that lands me a seat at the dinner table.
: Yeah, well...
: We were sharing that...family-pack of meat anyway, so...
: You wouldn’t have been able to eat regardless.
: Maybe that’s why we didn’t save you a seat.
: Heheh...maybe.
: Yeah...
: Still sucks eating alone, though.
Noriko’s affection has increased to [noriko_love]!
